scenario_summary: Quantitative hedge fund accesses DataStream's real-time market data and alternative data API. Fixed SaaS base covers 1M API calls/month; calls above that threshold are billed at $0.01/call. The overage is variable consideration estimated by expected value and constrained under ASC 606-10-32-11.

performance_obligations.name: Market Data SaaS (Base)
performance_obligations.description: 12-month access to DataStream's real-time equities, options, and alternative data feeds. Includes up to 1,000,000 API calls per month. FinEdge's quant models poll the API continuously during market hours. Fixed monthly fee of $10,000.

ssp.basis: $10,000/month list price for the Standard Quant tier (up to 1M calls/month)

performance_obligations.name: API Call Overage
performance_obligations.description: Additional API calls above the 1M/month included threshold, billed at $0.01 per call. FinEdge is expanding its crypto and FX data consumption; overage is likely but the amount depends on strategy roll-out timing and market conditions.

variable_consideration.description: FinEdge is a mid-size quant fund expanding into crypto arbitrage strategies that will increase API consumption. Q3 strategy launch may spike usage significantly. Historical overage at comparable funds averages $10k–$20k/year. Constraint applied to base scenario.

scenarios.label: base
scenarios._note: Crypto strategy live H2; ~1.5M extra calls/month in Q3–Q4

scenarios.label: high
scenarios._note: Full crypto + FX rollout; ~4M extra calls/month year-round

variable_consideration._constraint_rationale: High scenario is possible but not probable at signing — crypto strategy is still in development. Constrain to base ($15k) per ASC 606-10-32-11: including the high scenario would create a probable significant reversal risk.

payment_schedule._note: Overage billed in arrears at year-end based on actuals
